description.value:
Trauma Team kept the Kildare's promise: the world's best surgeons, tireless. The Osler carries a self-refilling Blood Pump and the steadiest hands money can buy. The company's reasoning is that a great surgeon shouldn't be lost to something as small as dying.

Cost: 13,600eb (Very Expensive)
Humanity Loss: 44 (13d6)
Frame: Sigma (12): BODY 12
Eyes: MonoVision
Chrome: Amplified Hearing, Blood Pump, Image Enhance, Low Light/Infrared/UV, Medscanner (arm), MicroOptics, Radio Communicator, Raven Microcybernetics MicroWaldo, Techscanner (arm), Tool Hand

Every body includes the standard chassis (Cyberarm ×2, Cyberaudio Suite, Cyberleg ×2, Cyberskull, an Internal Linear Frame and a Neuroport) at no HL, plus its eyes and base chrome. Going metal needs a Biosystem (bought separately) and a Hospital.

Drop it on a character (as GM) to install it with Go Metal.

Item Compendium (2070) • Full Body Conversions
